title: Fractions and decimals
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. Write every fraction in simplest form.

items.prompt: Write as a fraction in simplest form:  0.35
Write as a fraction in simplest form:  0.875
A recipe needs {3/4} of a cup of milk. Your measuring cup is marked in decimals. What decimal should you fill it to?
Jada says 0.6 = {1/6}. Is she right? Explain, and write 0.6 as a fraction in simplest form.
Write as a fraction in simplest form:  0.15
A basketball player made {17/25} of her free throws this season. Write that as a decimal.
A screw is 0.125 inches long. Write its length as a fraction of an inch in simplest form.
Omar says {1/4} = 0.4. Is he right? Explain, and give the correct decimal.
